clue.text: Full extent of fighting in league, for example

definitions.meaning: a boxer who lasts every scheduled round is said to go the full length of the bout
a league is an old measure of length, about three miles

explanation.surface: A description of how far the warring reaches across some alliance of nations.
explanation.definitionFit: Going the distance means lasting a whole fight, and a league is one unit of length.

clue.text: Imagining one's repeating a term of French

definitions.text: Imagining one's repeating a term of French

parts.words: Imagining one's repeating a term of French
parts.note: the illusion of living through a moment a second time, named by a French expression

explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase means 'already seen', the feeling of having experienced the present before.

clue.text: Son is more than a revolutionary leader

parts.note: something that is more than X 'ain't just' X, in slangy terms

explanation.surface: A father boasts that his boy outshines a radical figurehead.
explanation.walkthrough: AIN'T is colloquial for 'isn't'. Saint-Just was a leader of the French Revolution, executed with Robespierre.
explanation.definitionFit: Louis de Saint-Just was a Jacobin leader of the French Revolution's Terror.

clue.text: Island parliament hesitant after leader moves to centre

indicators.note: the first letter of the word is shifted to its middle

parts.note: halting means hesitant, as in halting speech

explanation.surface: An island assembly falters once its chief takes a centrist position.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' is a link. Moving H from the front of HALTING to the middle gives ALT-H-ING.
explanation.definitionFit: The Althing is the parliament of Iceland, one of the oldest in the world.

clue.text: Caught with one piece of fishing equipment or another

parts.note: c is the cricket abbreviation for caught
a reel winds an angler's line

explanation.surface: An angler is arrested holding some tackle or other.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' is the definition: another piece of fishing equipment, the one the charade builds.
explanation.definitionFit: A creel is an angler's wicker basket, a different item of fishing tackle from the one in the wordplay.

clue.text: Having a meaning, not having a purpose

parts.note: the drift of a remark is its gist or meaning

explanation.surface: A contrast between something significant and something aimless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Having' is a link: the clue reads 'having a drift', A + DRIFT.
explanation.definitionFit: Being adrift is drifting without direction or aim, like a boat cut loose.

clue.text: Traveller in America provided one of a dozen Christmas presents

definitions.meaning: an American term for a travelling salesman

definitions.text: one of a dozen Christmas presents
definitions.meaning: the carol's true love gives twelve of these, drumming, on the twelfth day

explanation.surface: An American travelling salesman supplies one of the Twelve Days of Christmas gifts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'provided' is a link between the two senses.
explanation.definitionFit: Old US slang for a commercial traveller, and the twelfth day of the carol brings twelve of them drumming.

clue.text: One house in Ireland turning up in epic

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: in a down entry turning up means reading the word from bottom to top

parts.note: the Dail is the lower house of the Irish parliament

explanation.surface: A single Irish home is upside down in a heroic story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' reverses DAIL to LIAD; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Homer's Iliad is the epic poem of the Trojan War.

clue.text: Was no safety measure set up for this tool?

indicators.note: in a down entry set up means the whole run is written from the bottom upwards

parts.note: taken as written
a net is a safety measure under a trapeze or high wire

explanation.surface: A question about whether any precautions were put in place for a piece of equipment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' reverses WAS NO NET in one go.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenon saw is a small stiff-backed saw used for cutting joints.

clue.text: Fish large stream as partner in sporting event

parts.note: cod is a fish
a river is a large stream

explanation.surface: Someone goes fishing in a big river with a companion during a competition.
explanation.definitionFit: In rallying, the co-driver sits beside the driver and reads the route notes.

clue.text: United congressional action showing firmness on cannabis

indicators.note: in an across clue 'on' means placed after, so the firmness word follows the cannabis word

parts.note: a joint is a cannabis cigarette
resolution is firmness of purpose

explanation.surface: Lawmakers take a firm stance on marijuana policy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'showing' is a link between definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: In the US a measure passed by both houses of Congress together is called this kind of resolution.

clue.text: Bitter words from wise men, say, in small village

indicators.note: the trio of wise men sits inside the abbreviation for village

parts.note: vil. is a short form of village
the three wise men are an example of a trio

explanation.surface: The Magi spout something nasty while staying in a hamlet.
explanation.definitionFit: Vitriol is caustic, bitter criticism, named from sulphuric acid.

clue.text: First person back, having sped around fast

indicators.note: the word for sped goes around the reversed first man

parts.note: ran is a synonym of sped

indicators.note: back tells us to read the first man's name from right to left

parts.note: Adam was the first man in Genesis

explanation.surface: Someone races round a track to return to where they started.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fast' looks like it means speedy, but here it is the noun: a period of going without food.
explanation.definitionFit: Ramadan is the Muslim month of daytime fasting.

clue.text: Writer's drive in opening round

definitions.note: read as 'writer is', so the 's is a link between definition and wordplay

indicators.note: the word for drive goes into the reversed opening
round tells us to turn the word for opening back to front

parts.note: a vent is an opening
urge means drive, as an impulse

explanation.surface: An author's ambition shows from the first round of a contest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drive' suggests motoring and 'round' a boxing bout; the 's of 'Writer's' is just 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivan Turgenev was the Russian novelist of Fathers and Sons.

clue.text: Rescue vessel in drama circling a small island

indicators.note: the drama word goes round the a

parts.note: Noh is classical Japanese drama
Sark is a small Channel Island

explanation.surface: A play features a boat sailing round a little isle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link. Sark is one of the Channel Islands between England and France.
explanation.definitionFit: The ark of Genesis saved Noah's family and the animals from the Flood.

clue.text: Dance rhythm derived from drum, basically

indicators.note: derived from says the letters come out of the following words

explanation.surface: A Latin beat is built on the drum.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across 'dRUM BAsically'; 'basically' only supplies letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The rumba is a Cuban dance and the rhythm it is danced to.

clue.text: Maine's not represented here — it's another state

indicators.note: represented hints that the letters are presented anew in a different order

parts.note: the state's name with its s kept as a letter
taken as written

explanation.surface: A remark that one US state is absent from somewhere, while another is there.
explanation.walkthrough: 'here' is a link; the letters of MAINE'S NOT reorder into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Minnesota is a US state, different from Maine.

clue.text: City centre

parts.note: an arts and residential complex in the City of London, the capital's financial district

explanation.walkthrough: 'City' with a capital is the City of London, the old square mile, not any town.
explanation.definitionFit: The Barbican Centre is a large arts venue inside the City of London.

clue.text: An unknown investigator American people

parts.note: in algebra x, y and z stand for unknowns
tec is short for detective

explanation.surface: A mysterious detective studies a people of the Americas.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed page reads 'investigator of American people': 'of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The Aztecs were the native people who ruled central Mexico before the Spanish conquest.

clue.text: Jumped over and became free

definitions.meaning: a horse that jumps a fence has gone over it
the road or sky became free of obstruction

explanation.surface: A horse vaulted the fence and escaped.
explanation.definitionFit: A hurdle is cleared when jumped, and a debtor or backlog is cleared when freed of burden.

clue.text: Giving personal advice about border plant

indicators.note: the advice word goes round the border word

parts.note: an agony aunt or agony column gives readers personal advice
a rim is a border or edge

explanation.surface: A gardener counsels someone about what to put along the edge of a bed.
explanation.walkthrough: An agony aunt is a British newspaper advice columnist.
explanation.definitionFit: Agrimony is a yellow-flowered herb of the rose family.

clue.text: Asian or South American outside US city

indicators.note: the word for the American people goes outside the city

parts.note: the Maya were a people of Central and South America
LA is Los Angeles

explanation.surface: A traveller from Asia or Latin America lives on the edge of an American city.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from Malaya, now part of Malaysia, is Asian.

clue.text: Continued or discontinued

definitions.meaning: stopped or halted, as a court halts an execution

explanation.surface: A paradox: something both went on and stopped.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay is to remain, and to stay proceedings is to suspend them.

clue.text: Speedy traveller not taken to Aix

definitions.text: Speedy traveller not taken to Aix

parts.words: Speedy traveller not taken to Aix
parts.note: the saying that ill tidings travel fast, set against Browning's poem in which riders carry good tidings from Ghent to Aix

explanation.walkthrough: Robert Browning's poem is 'How They Brought the Good News from Ghent to Aix'.
explanation.definitionFit: Proverbially unwelcome tidings spread quickly, and Browning's riders carried the happy kind instead.

clue.text: Protest over bishop, hence removal from service

parts.note: a demo is a protest march
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A demonstration against a bishop leads to his being dismissed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' places DEMO above B in this down entry; 'hence' is a link. Demob is British slang for leaving the armed forces.
explanation.definitionFit: Demob is short for demobilisation, release from military service.

clue.text: How people in America may be called for prayer

definitions.text: How people in America may be called
definitions.meaning: an American call charged to the person receiving it is placed this way
a short liturgical prayer for a particular day

explanation.surface: Describing how worshippers in the US are summoned to church.
explanation.definitionFit: In the US a reverse-charge call is made this way, and the word is also a brief set prayer.

clue.text: Marks secured by fellow who's the best performer?

indicators.note: the marks are held inside the fellow

parts.note: a chap is a fellow
M stands for marks, the old German currency

explanation.surface: A man who earns top marks is the star of the show.
explanation.definitionFit: Champ is short for champion, the one who beats everyone.

clue.text: Leaves for shooting without any setters

definitions.text: Leaves for shooting without any setters

parts.words: Leaves for shooting without any setters
parts.note: pages that are ready to be photographed for printing with no further typesetting needed

explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaves' are pages, 'shooting' is photographing them for the press, and 'setters' are typesetters, not dogs or puzzle compilers.
explanation.definitionFit: Material laid out so that it can be photographed directly for printing plates.

clue.text: Lightweight criticism of wine

definitions.meaning: a wine taster might complain it lacks fullness

explanation.surface: A dismissal of a feeble wine and of a feeble person.
explanation.definitionFit: An unimportant person is a nobody, and a thin wine has 'no body'.

clue.text: Type mostly found in Madrid and Paris, perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the letters of the phrase could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A kind of person commonly seen in the Spanish and French capitals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' looks like it qualifies Paris as an example, but it rearranges AND PARIS.
explanation.definitionFit: Most people in the Spanish capital are natives of Spain.
